channel.title: Worth — money calculators and guides
channel.description: Free calculators and 40 guides that turn prices into hours of work, annualise recurring costs and show what small amounts add up to.

item.title: Cost of Time Calculator
item.description: Find how many work hours a purchase costs using your after-tax hourly, monthly, or annual pay. Free calculator with the formula and worked examples.

item.title: Subscription Cost Calculator
item.description: Convert monthly subscription fees into annual costs and hours of work. See the real cost of streaming, apps, and memberships with a free calculator.

item.title: Daily Savings Calculator
item.description: See how saving $1, $5, or $10 a day adds up over a year. Calculate simple daily savings without assumed investment returns or interest.

item.title: How to calculate what an hour of your life is worth
item.description: Your salary is one number. The money available to spend is another. Start with your pay after taxes and deductions, then divide it by the number of hours y

item.title: The small purchases that aren’t actually small
item.description: A $5 coffee is a $5 coffee. Every day for a year, it is $1,825. Neither framing is more correct, but seeing both helps you make a choice instead of followi

item.title: The 24-hour rule: a little space before you spend
item.description: For a nonessential purchase, wait a day before buying. Put it on a list, close the tab, and come back tomorrow. The point is not to make spending difficult

item.title: Salary to Hourly Calculator
item.description: Convert annual salary to hourly rate instantly. Formula: salary ÷ 2080. Free, open-source calculator with overtime and after-tax adjustments. GitHub source.

item.title: Hourly to Salary Calculator
item.description: Convert hourly wage to annual salary: hourly × 2080. Free calculator shows monthly, weekly, after-tax. Open source on GitHub.

item.title: Freelance Hourly Rate Calculator
item.description: Freelance rate calculator: (salary + expenses + profit) ÷ billable hours. Includes taxes, benefits, PTO. Free, open source on GitHub.

item.title: Cost Per Wear Calculator
item.description: Cost per wear = price ÷ wears. Calculate true clothing value. $200 jacket worn 100 times = $2/wear. Free open source calculator.

item.title: Cost Per Use Calculator
item.description: Cost per use = price ÷ uses. Calculate true value of gadgets, tools, memberships. Free calculator, open source on GitHub.

item.title: Overtime Pay Calculator
item.description: Calculate overtime pay: time and a half = 1.5× hourly. Double time = 2×. Free calculator with weekly, biweekly. Open source.

item.title: After Tax Income Calculator
item.description: Calculate take-home pay after federal, state, FICA. Enter gross salary, get net hourly, monthly. Free, open source GitHub.

item.title: Cost of Commuting Calculator
item.description: Commute cost calculator: gas + time + wear + lost wages. 1 hour commute = $12,500/year in time alone. Free, GitHub open source.

item.title: Latte Factor Calculator
item.description: Latte factor calculator: daily $5 habit = $1,825/year. See 10, 30 year total. Free calculator, open source on GitHub.

item.title: Gym Cost Per Visit Calculator
item.description: Gym cost per visit = monthly fee ÷ visits. $50/month ÷ 4 visits = $12.50/visit. Free calculator, open source GitHub.

item.title: Streaming Cost Calculator
